WITH observed AS (
    SELECT c.constructorId, r.year, r.round, cs.points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
    LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT constructorId) AS constructors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN points IS NOT NULL THEN constructorId END) AS with_standings,
       MIN(points) AS minimum_points, MAX(points) AS maximum_points,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM observed WHERE year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY constructorId, year, round HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)) AS repeated_rounds
FROM observed

WITH season_standings AS (
    SELECT cs.constructorId, cs.points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year
               ORDER BY r.round DESC
           ) AS latest
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
),
career_totals AS (
    SELECT c.name, c.url, COALESCE(SUM(s.points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN season_standings AS s
        ON s.constructorId = c.constructorId AND s.latest = 1
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT name, career_points, url,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS career_rank
    FROM career_totals
)
SELECT name, career_points, url
FROM ranked
WHERE career_rank <= 3
ORDER BY career_rank, name
